protocol.scope: Adaptive development experiment on already inspected LeFood data, not an independent final evaluation or reproduction of DPF-Nutrition.
protocol.hypothesis: Frozen relative-depth shape features add predictive information beyond appearance and imperfect food-mask area.
protocol.extraction: EXIF-corrected RGB; pinned official slow image processor with default aspect-preserving resize; frozen local safetensors model, no remote code; resize raw inverse-depth output bilinearly to 256x256 for aligned feature extraction; no labels used.
protocol.geometry: Normalize each image by its own 5th/95th depth percentiles. Fit a plane in normalized pixel coordinates to a 15-pixel-wide dilated ring outside the frozen food mask. This ring is not verified plate surface. Record residual shape statistics inside food; missing reference if fewer than 32 ring pixels. Features are dimensionless cues, never grams, metric height or physical volume.
protocol.features: Per image: food area; valid-reference flag; signed median and 90th percentile residual; residual std; positive residual sum / image area; positive residual fraction; ring residual std; whole-image normalized depth std. Pair: before, after, after-minus-before. Compare Change baseline, Change+Mask control, Change+Depth, Change+Mask+Depth.
protocol.evaluation: Original five LeFood outer test sets and 50-label inner folds, checked for group/component/raw-image boundary overlap. Same 13-candidate group-weighted RBF regression search per new feature family. Standardization fitted only inside each fitting partition. No sample-specific correction, relabeling or exclusions.
protocol.selection: Inner group-balanced MAE; gamma {0.5,2,8} x alpha {0.01,0.1,1,10}, plus constant group-weighted median. Clip to [0,1.25].
protocol.limitations: Residue/portion confusion cannot be scored without independent visual labels. Recorded zero and small-positive mass slices are proxies with different meaning. Relative depth has per-image scale/shift ambiguity, and pretraining overlap is unknown. All results are conditional development evidence. No automatic deployment.

evaluation_amendment.timing: Added while feature extraction ran, before any depth model fitting or outcome inspection.
evaluation_amendment.reason: The original Change bank has 25 candidates. Add a scalar-only ChangeControl using the same standardization and 13 candidates as depth variants for a strictly matched ablation.
evaluation_amendment.comparison: ChangeDepth versus ChangeControl; ChangeMaskDepth versus ChangeMask. Keep original Change as the deployment and promotion baseline.
evaluation_amendment.clarification: Both depth variants use the frozen food mask to locate feature regions. Removing mask area features does not remove dependence on that mask. This is not an evaluation of a depth-only food detector.
